name: hud_ui_triplet_panel_destructor_core
description: HudUiTripletPanel::DestructorCore destroys the three child widgets and restores the base common table.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja shows the retail body includes compiler-generated EH frame setup and MSVC_EH_ArrayDestructor glue; the source spells the destructor loop directly.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40d610 calls MSVC_EH_ArrayDestructor over three HudUiWidget items at self+0x3c, then writes g_HudUiCommon_FTable to the panel base.
0x4b3d50 HudUiWidget::DestructorCore is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_widget_destructor_core.

The native triplet-panel destructor smoke constructs a panel with three owned item images, calls HudUiTripletPanel::DestructorCore, and verifies all item images are released and the base table is g_HudUiCommon_FTable.
